history.text:
Tentu, ini lirik lagu "Heaven and Back" oleh Dean Lewis:

(Verse 1)
I'm in the city, I'm in the town
I'm in the country, I'm upside down
I'm in the mountains, I'm in the sea
I'm in the darkness, you're all I see

(Pre-Chorus)
And I've been searching, I've been lost
Trying to find my way across
But every time I stumble, every time I fall
You're the one I'm running to, you're my all

(Chorus)
You take me to heaven and back again
You make me feel like I can do anything
With you by my side, I can conquer the world
You're my light, my guide, my everything

(Verse 2)
I've seen the stars, I've seen the sun
I've felt the rain, I've had my fun
But nothing compares to the joy you bring
You're the song my heart wants to sing

(Pre-Chorus)
And I've been searching, I've been lost
Trying to find my way across
But every time I stumble, every time I fall
You're the one I'm running to, you're my all

(Chorus)
You take me to heaven and back again
You make me feel like I can do anything
With you by my side, I can conquer the world
You're my light, my guide, my everything

(Bridge)
And even when the storms come, and the skies turn gray
I know that you'll be there to light up my way
You're the anchor that holds me, the calm in the storm
You keep me safe and warm

(Chorus)
You take me to heaven and back again
You make me feel like I can do anything
With you by my side, I can conquer the world
You're my light, my guide, my everything

(Outro)
Heaven and back, heaven and back
With you, I'm never looking back
Heaven and back, heaven and back
You're all I need, that's a fact.
